previousOfferSnapshot.offerNote: 20,000 bonus points after $1,000 in purchases in the first 90 days, worth $200 onboard credit or $200 off a Norwegian cruise. No annual fee and no foreign transaction fee.

cards.name: IHG One Rewards Premier Select
cards.offerNote: Official public channel reviewed 2026-11-16: 150,000 IHG points; $4,000 qualifying purchases within 3 months; $350 ongoing annual fee. Additional 10,000 for adding an authorized user in 3 months is excluded from base bonus.

previousOfferSnapshot.offerNote: Official Chase launch offer: 200,000 IHG One Rewards points after $5,000 in purchases in the first 3 months; $350 annual fee. Plus 10,000 points after adding an authorized user in the first 3 months. Eligibility is card-specific: current cardmembers or prior cardmembers who received this card bonus within 24 months are restricted.

cards.additionalRequirement: Add an authorized user within the first 3 months; see linked channel terms.
